name: Ant, Giant
description: Large eusocial insect exhibiting extreme aggression when defending tunnels or larvae. Individuals show no self-preservation once the colony is threatened.

name: Ash Nomad
description: Ash Nomads are hardened wanderers who survive by scavenging the ruins and ash-choked Deadlands, favoring practical gear and caution over open conflict. They are wary, opportunistic, and quick to defend territory or exploit weakness when necessary.

name: Cannibal Scavenger
description: Desperate and feral survivors who hunt the Deadlands for meat and salvage, cannibal scavengers rely on ambush, crude weapons, and sheer ruthlessness.

name: Fly, Giant
description: Rapid-breeding carrion insect drawn to waste, corpses, and open wounds. Its presence often precedes outbreaks of disease and infestation.

name: Ghoul
description: c

name: Nilbog
description: Reality-distorted creature exhibiting erratic behavior and localized causality anomalies. Prolonged observation induces discomfort and confusion.

name: ROUS
description: Giant, fearless rodents with powerful jaws that persistently gnaw through barriers and return repeatedly, favoring debris-filled environments until prey or obstacles give way.
specialOne: Terrifting Size: The first time each character is attacked by an ROUS during an encounter, they must succeed on a DC 12 Resist Save or suffer –1 to all attack rolls against the ROUS until the end of their next turn.

name: Scorpion, Cave
description: Subterranean arthropod adapted to total darkness. Hunts by vibration and ambush, striking from concealment with sudden precision.
specialOne: Cave Scorpion Venom Archetype: Paralytic Delivery: Injury (stinger) Save: Toughness DC12 Effect: On a failed save, the target is Paralyzed (cannot take Large Actions; movement reduced to 0) Duration: 1 minute per failed save Removal: Successful Toughness save (one per minute), Medicine, or Magic

name: Spider, Giant
description: Giant spiders lurk in ruins and vertical spaces, remaining motionless until prey slows or hesitates. They strike from above, using webbing and venom to trap victims before retreating back into shadow.
specialOne: Webs: The target must succeed on an DC11 Dodge Save (negates) or become stuck to their space, unable to move until they succeed on a Dodge Save on their turn or the webbing is destroyed by a skill check or fire.

name: Spider Swarm
description: Dense mass of smaller arachnids acting as a single organism. Causes panic and disorientation through overwhelming physical contact.
specialOne: Swarm: Can not be knocked prone, and can not target limbs

name: Tunnel Lurker
description: Humanoids adapted to subterranean environments, Tunnel Lurkers ambush from darkness and tight passages, striking quickly before retreating into cover.
specialOne: Sneak Attack: If the Tunnel Lurker hits a creature that is unaware, surprised, or flanked, the attack deals +1 damage.

name: Wasp, Giant
description: Highly territorial flying insect with persistent pursuit behavior. Known to attack far beyond initial provocation.
specialOne: Giant Wasp Venom: Injury; Toughness DC 12; on a failed save, the target becomes Winded for 1 round; does not stack.

name: Zombie, Slow
description: Decomposing humanoid animated by unknown forces. Movement is slow, but relentless pursuit makes it dangerous in confined spaces.
specialOne: Sneak Attack: If the Zombie hits a creature that is unaware, surprised, or flanked, the attack deals +1 damage.

name: Bone Prophet
description: Gaunt humanoid draped in bones and scavenged relics, using ritual preparation and close presence to enact unsettling effects rather than brute force.
specialOne: Bone Curse: The Bone Prophet makes a Hand 2 Hand melee attack; on a hit, the target must succeed on a Toughness Save (DC 12) or become Winded for 1 minute; each subsequent round while Winded, the target may spend a Small Action to attempt the save again, ending the effect on a success.

name: Bugbear
description: Bear-bodied brute with chitinous claws, an insectoid maw, and a huge stinger, relying on speed and relentless pressure rather than subtlety or tactics.
specialOne: The stinger injects a paralytic venom; on a hit, the target must succeed on a DC12 Resist Save or become Winded for 1 round.

name: Cannibal Reaver
description: Veteran cannibal enforcers who impose order through violence, Cannibal Reavers direct lesser scavengers in coordinated ambushes, maintaining discipline and brutality under fire.
specialOne: Sneak Attack: If the Cannibal Reaver hits a creature that is unaware, surprised, or flanked, the attack deals +1 damage.
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Bum Rush | Hard to Kill | -

name: Cult Enforcer (Choose Primordial)
description: A hardened cult shock trooper clad in scavenged armor and ritual markings, Cult Enforcers form the brutal frontline of cult forces, breaking enemies through strength, discipline, and fanatic resolve.
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Bum Rush | Hard to Kill | -

name: Cult Priest (Choose Primordial)
description: A robed devotee of forces older than gods, the Cult Priest channels alien divine power through whispered rites and ritual invocations that were never meant for human minds.
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Cat Like Reflexes | Hard to Kill | -

name: Direnoodle
description: At a glance, a Direnoodle resembles an oversized ferret with a playful gait. When it strikes, its jaw opens impossibly wide, revealing layered rows of paring-knife teeth before snapping shut and vanishing again.
specialOne: Ambush Skirmisher: If the Direnoodle makes a melee attack against a target it began its turn hidden from, it may immediately move up to half its movement without provoking an Attack of Opportunity.

name: Elemental Spawn: Ashling
description: A small, floating elemental creature about the size of a human head. Variants deal Fire, Ice, Electricity, or Acid damage and detonate when destroyed.

name: Elemental Spawn: Frostling
description: A small, floating elemental creature about the size of a human head. Variants deal Fire, Ice, Electricity, or Acid damage and detonate when destroyed.

name: Elemental Spawn: Arcling
description: A small, floating elemental creature about the size of a human head. Variants deal Fire, Ice, Electricity, or Acid damage and detonate when destroyed.

name: Elemental Spawn: Etchling
description: A small, floating elemental creature about the size of a human head. Variants deal Fire, Ice, Electricity, or Acid damage and detonate when destroyed.

name: Grave Shepard
description: A pale, jointless horror clings to ceilings by sinewed anchors, its elongated arms hanging limp until they snap downward to snare prey and haul them screaming upward.
specialOne: Director of the Dead: Undead within 20 ft of the Grave Shepherd gain +1 to attack rolls while it is conscious and able to give commands.

name: Meggot
description: A massive undead maggot of bloated, corpse-white flesh, the Meggot crawls forward on rippling segments, its feeding end dominated by a grotesquely human-looking mouth that chews and works even when it is still.
specialOne: Meggot Filth Poison: on successful bite target must make a DC 14 Toughness save or be poisoned. 1 min per save, no LAs, no movement, fail by 5+ and target falls prone
specialTwo: Carrion Feeder: The Meggot deals +1d6 damage to Paralyzed or Prone targets.

name: Raider Enforcer
description: Veteran raiders tasked with enforcing discipline and violence within raider bands, Enforcers are blunt instruments who maintain order through fear and force.

name: ROEUS
description: A massive aggressive rodent bred into a brutal apex scavenger.

name: Singed Ash Nomad
description: Ash Nomads who survived prolonged exposure to firestorms and irradiated glass-fields, their gear scorched and their bodies permanently marked by heat and smoke.
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Hard to Kill | - | -

name: Tetherling
description: A pale, jointless horror clings to ceilings by sinewed anchors, its elongated arms hanging limp until they snap downward to snare prey and haul them screaming upward.
specialOne: Ceiling Snare: If the Tetherling hits a target with Lashing Arm while attached to a ceiling or wall, it may immediately grab the target with its elongated limb. The target is restrained by the limb until they escape using an appropriate opposed skill check (such as Athletics, Hand 2 Hand, or another GM-approved skill)
specialTwo: Anchored Horror: While attached to a ceiling or wall, the Tetherling gains +2 TAC against melee attacks made from below.

name: Walters
description: A dog-sized amphibian mutant, Walters are aggressive creatures marked by an exposed, human-like brain pulsing atop their skull.
specialOne: Erratic Reflexes: The first time each round a Walter is missed by a melee attack, it may immediately move up to 5 ft without provoking an Attack of Opportunity.

name: Wild Wizard
description: A scavenger spellcaster who survives through stealth, stolen knowledge, and half-understood magic, Wild Wizards blend arcane tricks with thief instincts.
specialOne: Arcane Skulker: If the Wild Wizard begins its turn hidden, it gains +1 to spell DCs until the end of that turn.

name: Zombie, Fast
description: Recently reanimated corpse retaining bursts of speed and coordination. Often lethal before victims recognize the threat.
specialOne: Sneak Attack
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Hard to Kill | - | -

name: Ash Nomad Longwalker
description: Veteran pathfinders who range far beyond settled Deadlands, Longwalkers are hardened scouts and marksmen trusted to survive weeks alone in ash and ruin.
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Cat Like Reflexes | Hard to Kill | -

name: Bone Breaker
description: A brutal cult enforcer hardened by ritual scars and heavy armor, Bone Breakers stride into the front line, shattering bodies while chanting grim rites through clenched teeth.
specialOne: Sneak Attack: If the Tunnel Lurker hits a creature that is unaware, surprised, or flanked, the attack deals +1 damage.

name: Cannibal Booshare
description: The Booshare is the butcher-chief of a cannibal pack, directing hunts and feasts alike through intimidation, crude signals, and absolute control over food and survival.
specialOne: Sneak Attack: If the Cannibal Booshare hits a creature that is unaware, surprised, or flanked, the attack deals +3 damage.
smallAction: Break Their Guard | Bum Rush | Hard to Kill | Command

name: Cult Leader
description: A commanding cult lieutenant driving followers through fear and fanatic devotion.

name: Light Consumer
description: A shifting mass of shadow and cold absence, the Light Consumer feeds on illumination, dimming and extinguishing light as it closes in on its prey.
specialOne: Consume Light: Non-magical light sources within 20 ft of the Light Consumer are immediately extinguished. Magical light entering this area is suppressed while within the radius (returns when removed)
smallAction: Bum Rush | Cleaving | Hard to Kill | -

name: Lo Pan’s Eye
description: A floating fleshy orb serving as a magical sentry and observer.
specialOne: All Around Vision

name: Sh’alud
description: A stone-sheathed horror of a subterranean worm that moves with unsettling patience, a Sh’alud emerges to strike, tests its prey’s strength, and withdraws beneath the earth when resistance proves too great.

name: Terrorbirb
description: A towering, flightless hunter built for open ground, the Terrorbirb relies on brutal acceleration and a crushing beak strike to overwhelm prey in seconds.
specialOne: Line Breaker: When the Terrorbirb reduces a target to 0 HP with a melee attack during a charge, it may continue moving up to half its remaining movement without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.

name: Tunnel Witch
description: Humanoids adapted to subterranean environments, Tunnel Lurkers ambush from darkness and tight passages, striking quickly before retreating into cover.
specialOne: Sneak Attack: If the Tunnel Lurker hits a creature that is unaware, surprised, or flanked, the attack deals +1 damage.

name: Whobeast
description: A massive mutant brute with a hulking body and an unmistakable owl-like face, the Whobeast is territorial, violent, and terrifyingly strong when roused.
specialOne: Line Breaker: When the Terrorbirb reduces a target to 0 HP with a melee attack during a charge, it may continue moving up to half its remaining movement without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.
smallAction: Bum Rush | Cleaving | Hard to Kill | -

name: WTEF
description: Advanced Walters variant exhibiting higher reasoning and tactical awareness, and some magical ability. WTEFs are hulking amphibian horrors whose swollen bodies and reinforced cranial domes protect a violently active human-like brain.
specialOne: Erratic Reflexes: The first time each round a WTEF is missed by a melee attack, it may immediately move up to 5 ft without provoking an Attack of Opportunity.
specialTwo: Predatory Snap: If the WTEF hits a creature with Tongue Whip, it gains +2 on its next Bite attack against that same target before the end of its next turn.
smallAction: Cat Like Reflexes | Hard to Kill | - | -
